purpose: Machine-readable contract for provider series observations, quality, licensing, and release-time provenance; proposal only, not the existing acquisition manifest schema.

types.source: string provider code; market, fred, banxico, ecb, boe, boj, bis
types.frequency: enum: daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, unknown
types.units: provider-native string or null, no inferred conversion
types.source_response_sha256: 64-character SHA256 hex or null if response unavailable
types.availability_evidence: object {kind, earliest_known_utc, reference}; all nullable; unknown is not zero-lag
types.missing_source_rows: integer or null, may be unavailable for old providers
types.transformation: null for raw data; downstream transformations in separately versioned artifacts

invariants: unique (provider, dataset version, series_id, observation_date) within one immutable snapshot
all stored dates strictly ascending and within inclusive start / exclusive end
finite stored numeric values; explicitly missing provider observations are omitted only with audited counts
response SHA256 computed before parsing; stored CSV SHA256 verified independently
release-time availability requires per-observation independent evidence, never a release calendar guess
licensed or proprietary raw data must not be committed by default
external stress indices must be flagged as validation outcomes rather than automatically used as latent factor inputs
adoption: A coordinator must approve changes to the shared manifest/source-catalog schema before implementation.
